Desc_Condition: Runs the instruction set only while the NSTN sky model rates the chosen band as worth exposing for this target. Checked between instructions; a running exposure is finished, never aborted.
Desc_Wait: Waits until one of the NSTN windows of the blocks in this instruction set opens. The bands come from their '{t:Name_Condition}' conditions. Put it first in a loop around those blocks, so the loop does not spin while every window is closed.
Desc_NightInfo: Shows the night for this target: twilight, moon phase and altitude, the target's altitude and distance to the moon, the sky towards the target and tonight's NSTN windows. Checks how the target's sequence is built and explains the recommended structure. Takes no time when it runs.
Desc_Plan: One row per filter: its name as in the profile, exposures per round and exposure time. The row 'L/RGB' combines L, R, G and B in a ratio. Waits for the first NSTN window, then exposes each row while its window is open, round after round, until no window opens again this night. Gain, offset, binning and sets in a row apply to the whole plan.
Name_NightLeft: Loop while an NSTN window opens tonight
Desc_NightLeft: Keeps the instruction set running while at least one NSTN block inside it is open now or opens later tonight. Ends it after the last window of the night, without a fixed time.
Plan_StopAfter: Stop after failed exposures in a row
Plan_OutlineWait: 1. Wait for the first NSTN window
Plan_OutlineRowOnce: {0}. {1} per round, only while its window is open
Plan_OutlineRowRepeat: {0}. {1} per round, {2} sets in a row, only while its window is open
Plan_OutlineRowPriority: {0}. {1} with priority: takes over after the running exposure once its window opens, then runs alone
Plan_AdjustHint: Priority, a stricter or looser threshold, a minimum altitude or a time span for this filter only. Empty or 0 keeps the plugin options.
Plan_RatioHint: L:R:G:B – exposures per round, e.g. 3:1:1:1; 0 leaves a filter out. L uses the L time, R, G and B the RGB time.
Plan_PriorityHint: When this row's window opens, it takes over after the running exposure; while it is open nothing else runs. Of two open rows with priority the upper one runs.
Plan_StrictnessHint: Added to the threshold of the plugin options, in mag/arcsec². +0.3 keeps this filter to darker sky (a shorter window), -0.3 lets it start in brighter sky.
Plan_MinAltitudeHint: The target's minimum altitude for this filter; empty uses the plugin options.
Plan_TimeHint: Local time as HH:mm, empty for no limit. Times before noon belong to the morning after.
Plan_OutlineEnd: The rounds repeat until no window opens again this night.
Plan_OutlineStop: Ends early after {0} failed exposures in a row.
Plan_IssueUnknownFilter: Filter '{0}' is not in the filter list of this profile ({nina:Options} > {nina:Equipment} > {nina:FilterWheel}).
Plan_IssueLrgbFilter: L/RGB: no filter for {0} in the profile. NSTN finds it by its name: {0} or {1}.
Plan_IssueMismatch: The instructions inside do not match the rows; editing a row rebuilds them.
Plan_Stopped: NSTN filter plan ended: {0} exposures in a row failed. Check the camera and the image folder.
NightLeft_None: No NSTN block inside - nothing to do.
NightLeft_Until: Runs until the last window closes ({0}).
NightLeft_While: Runs while a window still opens this night.
NightLeft_Done: No window opens again this night.
NightLeft_Stopped: Ended: {0} exposures in a row failed.
Preset_Custom: Custom: band and bandwidth by hand
Cond_FilterTip: Takes band and bandwidth from the NSTN filter tables. A suggestion: check the passbands of your own filter.
Cond_BandwidthTip: Bandwidth (FWHM) of the filter for this line
Cond_DuoHint: {0} opens earlier than {1} in this duo filter: while only {0} is open, the {1} channel of these frames is already flooded.
Cond_IssueBlockNoFilter: No {nina:SwitchFilter} or {nina:SmartExposure} with a filter in this block: choose the filter here directly.
Cond_IssueBlockSeveral: This block uses several filters ({0}): choose the filter here directly.
Cond_IssueUnassigned: Filter '{0}' has no NSTN assignment: {nina:Options} > {nina:Plugins} > NSTN, '{t:Options_FiltersTitle}'.

Wait_NoCondition: No NSTN condition to wait for
Wait_NothingTonight: No window opens again this night

Plan_LoopNotEstimated: Loop condition {0} is not part of the estimate; the plan runs until no window opens again.

Plan_Priority: {0} has no '{nina:LoopForIterations}': it keeps its window to itself (priority). Add one for a round robin.
Plan_Overhead: Estimate with {0:0} s overhead per exposure; autofocus, meridian flip, filter changes and slews are not included.

Info_IssueNoTarget: Place '{t:Name_NightInfo}' inside a target container: it shows the night for that target.
Info_BandsDefault: No NSTN condition below this target yet - the rows show the usual bands.
Info_CheckOk: Sequence check: the structure of this target follows the NSTN pattern.
Fact_DistanceText: {0} while the target is usable; the moon is up for {1} of that time
Tip_MoonDown: Moon below the horizon · {0:0}° from the target
Check_OnTarget: The NSTN condition sits on the target {0} itself: the whole target, slew and centring included, then only runs while that one window is open. Put it on a block inside the target instead.
Check_NoBlocks: No block below this target has a '{t:Name_Condition}' condition yet. Give every filter its own block (an instruction set with a filter switch and the exposures) and put the condition on that block.
Check_NoExposure: Block {0} contains no exposure: its window only decides when nothing is taken.
Check_WaitInBlock: '{t:Name_Wait}' sits inside block {0}. It belongs at the top of the loop that holds the blocks, not inside one of them.
Check_FilterMismatch: Block {0} uses filter {1}, but its condition watches {2}: the window of another band decides when {1} is exposed. Choose '{t:Preset_BlockFilterShort}' or the matching band.
Check_NeverAtSite: Block {0}: at this site's sky quality the window never opens, on any night. Lower the threshold in the plugin options or drop the block.
Check_ClosedTonight: Block {0}: its window does not open tonight, so the block is skipped all night.
Check_NoLoopCondition: {0} has no loop condition, so N.I.N.A. runs it exactly once: every block gets one turn and the target is done, however long the night. Add '{nina:LoopUntilTime}' (e.g. morning twilight) to {0}.
Check_NoWait: {0} loops but has no '{t:Name_Wait}'. While every window is closed - at dusk, or when the moon is up - N.I.N.A. 3.2 then races through the loop without a pause and floods the log. Put '{t:Name_Wait}' first in {0}.
Check_WaitNotFirst: Move '{t:Name_Wait}' to the top of {0}: whatever stands before it runs on every pass, even while all windows are closed.
Check_Priority: Block {0} has no '{nina:LoopForIterations}': it keeps its window to itself for as long as it is open, and the blocks after it only run once it closes. For a round robin add '{nina:LoopForIterations}' (1 = one turn per pass).
Check_Stray: {0} in {1} is not in an NSTN block: it is exposed on every pass, whatever the sky.
Check_NoFlip: No '{nina:MeridianFlip}' trigger: the target crosses the meridian at {0}, during the usable time. An equatorial mount needs the trigger on the target or on the sequence.
Check_PlanAfEveryChange: {0} changes the filter in every round, and '{nina:AutofocusAfterFilterChange}' focuses after every change - with {1} filters that is many autofocus runs a night. Raise '{t:Plan_RoundsPerFilter}' in the plan, or set focus offsets per filter and focus by time or temperature.
Check_AfterPlan: {1} comes after {0} in {2}. A filter plan runs until no window opens again tonight, so {1} gets no time tonight. Add its filters to the plan as rows instead.
Check_TooLow: {0} does not rise above {1:0}° tonight: no window can open.
Check_OnlyOutsideNight: {0} is above {1:0}° only outside the astronomical night.
Guide_Title: How to build an NSTN sequence
Guide_Easy: The easy way: '{t:Name_Plan}' builds this pattern from a table - one row per filter (name as in the profile, exposures per round, exposure time) - and ends when no window opens again tonight. The tree and the rules below are for building it by hand.
Guide_Tree:
{nina:TargetSet}   triggers: {nina:MeridianFlip}, {nina:AutofocusAfterFilterChange}, {nina:DitherAfterExposures}
├─ {t:Name_NightInfo}   shows the night, takes no time
├─ {nina:SlewAndCenter}, {nina:StartGuiding}
└─ {nina:SequentialSet} "Loop"   condition: {nina:LoopUntilTime} (morning twilight)
   ├─ {t:Name_Wait}   first in the loop
   ├─ Block "O III"   conditions: {t:Name_Condition} (O III) + {nina:LoopForIterations} 1
   │  └─ {nina:SmartExposure}   OIII 5 × 300 s
   ├─ Block "H-alpha"   the same with H-alpha
   └─ Block "L/RGB"   the same with L/RGB
Guide_Rules:
1. Conditions on an instruction set are loop conditions. A set with only the NSTN condition repeats as long as its window is open; a set with no condition at all runs exactly once.
2. One block per filter: an instruction set holding the filter switch and the exposures ({nina:SmartExposure} does both), with '{t:Name_Condition}' for that band. '{t:Preset_BlockFilterShort}' reads the band from the block's filter switch.
3. Add '{nina:LoopForIterations}' to every block for a round robin: each open block takes its turn once per pass, the count sets the weight. Without it the first open block keeps its window to itself.
4. The loop around the blocks needs its own end, such as '{nina:LoopUntilTime}' at morning twilight; without one the target is done after a single pass.
5. '{t:Name_Wait}' goes first in that loop. When every window is closed, N.I.N.A. 3.2 would otherwise race through the loop without a pause.
6. Triggers on the target container (or the whole sequence) fire between exposures: {nina:MeridianFlip}, {nina:AutofocusAfterFilterChange}, {nina:DitherAfterExposures}. Slewing, centring and guiding belong before the loop, not inside it.
7. A window is checked before every exposure. A running exposure is always finished, never aborted.
Assign_BroadbandChoice: Broadband: L, R, G, B or no filter
Assign_CustomChoice: Custom: line and bandwidth by hand
Assign_NameMismatch: - check: the filter's name says {0}, but {1} is set
Options_Intro: Settings of the active profile. The site's own sky quality is required; the thresholds are calibrated defaults and only need changing for bright sites.
Options_SqmHint: 0 = not set. A measured value, not a Bortle guess.
Options_ThresholdBroadbandHint: Default 20.6 · higher means: darker sky needed
Options_ThresholdNarrowbandHint: Default 23.1 · higher means: darker sky needed
Options_ThresholdOdd: {0}: {1:0.0} is not a usual value; the default is {2:0.0}. With a threshold this low the sky is practically always dark enough, and the window only follows the target's altitude.
Options_OverheadHint: Download, saving, dithering on average. Only for the estimate. Default 10
Options_SiteNote: Site latitude and longitude come from the N.I.N.A. profile ({nina:Options} > {nina:General} > {nina:Astrometry}); times are shown in this PC's local time.
Options_FiltersIntro: What each filter of the filter wheel list passes. A condition set to '{t:Preset_BlockFilterShort}' takes its band from here, so changing the filter of a {nina:SmartExposure} changes the band with it. Suggestions are only applied on request; a bandwidth is never guessed.
Options_NoFilters: The profile has no filters in its filter wheel list ({nina:Options} > {nina:Equipment} > {nina:FilterWheel}).
Options_Floors: Narrowband bands open only where the site is at least this dark: 3 nm {0:0.00}, 7 nm {1:0.00}, 12 nm {2:0.00} mag/arcsec².
